parsed.rationale: Both `HLSPlayerTests.stallFromPlaying` (line 90) and `HLSPlayerTests.recoveryFromStall` (line 102) reside in `Shared/Playback/Tests/HLSPlayerTests/HLSPlayerTests.swift` within the `Playback` package. Despite the `is_test` context flags being recorded as `false`, the file path (`Tests/HLSPlayerTests/HLSPlayerTests.swift`) and the enclosing type name (`HLSPlayerTests`) make it unambiguous that these are test methods. The two methods test distinct, sequential HLS player states — stalling from playing versus recovering from a stall — so any structural similarity is a natural consequence of testing adjacent state-machine transitions, not accidental duplication. Merging them would conflate two semantically separate test scenarios and reduce test clarity.
